**Does this fit the project's scope?**

Tmux Agent Tower is deliberately read-only/local-first (see README.md
"What it is (and isn't)" and docs/ROADMAP.md). Feature requests that send
input to agents, auto-approve prompts, or require a server/account are
likely out of scope for now.
